changes.reason: OSS-MINT-GUARD-3 (2026-10-10, review OSS-MINT-GUARD-2 G2): new rule E2E-NAME-OWNERSHIP-1, armed on src/__tests__/e2e-resource-isolation.test.ts @ vitest. The e2e-full/e2e-quick runner looks for every volume and network name its resolved compose config names in an UNFILTERED listing and refuses, before any start, when one exists whatever its labels: a foreign same-name volume (seen only unfiltered) gets no startup, no compose resource action, no down and no removal command. Red-proved on 5ff9eda (the review's counterexample: exit 0, one startup, one down --volumes) and by mutation.

OSS-MINT-GUARD-3 (2026-10-10, review OSS-MINT-GUARD-2 G4): new rule E2E-FIXTURE-ENDPOINT-1, armed on src/__tests__/e2e-expired-org-isolation.test.ts @ vitest. The expired-org fixture refuses, before any process or HTTP request, UI and IdP bases that are not loopback http at the harness's selected ports carried by full-run.sh; the former development ports 7104/7113 are refused with zero process calls and zero requests. Red-proved on 5ff9eda (the review's counterexample: one database command and a POST to localhost:7104) and by mutation.
